summary: Zul'jan rewards preassigned beam positions and deliberate Boneslicer line soaks that clear Ritual Venom.
actions: Preassign players to intercept all four Ritual of the Fang beams.
Players carrying Ritual Venom should line up for Boneslicer; one soak clears all of that player's stacks.
Place the resulting Bloodletting ground pools away from future movement and soak positions.

provenance.description: Original compact encounter summary corroborated against Wowhead's Patch 12.1 guide and Ritual Venom spell record.
